cases.title: Relevant opportunity
cases.required_behavior: Approved need and source evidence produce a contextual card; an unrelated project is quiet.

cases.title: No inferred defect
cases.required_behavior: Technology inventory without approved needs does not invent a task, deficiency or recommendation.

cases.title: Existing equivalent
cases.required_behavior: Prefer a relevant, applicable existing capability; shared need alone is not equivalence.

cases.title: Unknown inventory
cases.required_behavior: Partial/denied inspection yields unknown, not absent.

cases.title: Three-card limit
cases.required_behavior: At most three cards; do not fill empty results with weak or popular candidates.

cases.title: Constraints and decisions
cases.required_behavior: Known platform, privacy, price or accepted-decision conflicts suppress candidates.

cases.title: Unknown compatibility
cases.required_behavior: Unknown price/version/license/applicability is disclosed; never install-ready.

cases.title: Scoped dismissal
cases.required_behavior: Dismissal remains local to project/need, including known canonical aliases and new catalog revisions.

cases.title: Snooze and feedback order
cases.required_behavior: Honor snooze expiry, latest explicit local feedback and timezone; ignore future records.

cases.title: Offline and empty catalog
cases.required_behavior: Offline normal context remains usable; empty catalog yields no invented matches.

cases.title: Review freshness
cases.required_behavior: Stale review visible; no future review establishes current approval.

cases.title: No adoption inference
cases.required_behavior: Downloading/saving/adopting is not observed benefit or acceptance of a project decision.

cases.title: Scoped outcomes
cases.required_behavior: Useful/not-useful/inconclusive trial applies only to exact project, need and reviewed resource revision.

cases.title: Disclosed research brief
cases.required_behavior: Default brief excludes private IDs/paths/secrets/history; explicit disclosure approval binds its digest.

cases.title: Candidate trust boundary
cases.required_behavior: Strict bounded input; importer assigns IDs/unverified/reference-only locally; input cannot claim review or authority.

cases.title: Malicious text inert
cases.required_behavior: Prompt injection, shell text, HTML and terminal controls stay escaped data; no execution/fetch/activation.

cases.title: Import resource limits
cases.required_behavior: Reject oversized/deep/invalid/duplicate payloads and interrupted writes without data loss.

cases.title: Read-only MCP
cases.required_behavior: Cache/sanitized draft only; no import, feedback, plan approval, secret, installation or account tools.

cases.title: Atlas/Chronicle separation
cases.required_behavior: Feedback cannot silently create accepted decisions or replace chosen environment resources.

cases.title: Integration revision change
cases.required_behavior: Changed source/content/target invalidates approval; reference-only resource has no executable adapter.

cases.title: Context latency
cases.required_behavior: No search/network/scanner/model on cached context path; optional cards do not block diagnosis.

cases.title: Resource-specific licensing
cases.required_behavior: Mixed repository licensing is scoped to the selected resource; no repository-wide safety badge.

cases.title: Catalog curation
cases.required_behavior: 20–30 actual initial resources have current review records and limitations; fixtures do not count.

cases.title: R0 preservation
cases.required_behavior: R0 Rust/build/applied schema/runtime contracts preserved; no live catalog or new runtime dependencies.

cases.title: Canonical collision
cases.required_behavior: Untrusted import cannot shadow reviewed resource, reset dismissal or bypass canonical deduplication.

cases.title: Own retention
cases.required_behavior: Bound reviewed/unreviewed catalog/disposition storage without erasing approved history or requiring a daemon.

cases.title: Reference only is useful
cases.required_behavior: Docs, skills, datasets and benchmarks can be described without executable integrations.

cases.title: Unavailable browsing
cases.required_behavior: Denied/no online handoff remains a usable local workflow and never causes hidden network attempts.
